identity.title: Detect exact-byte overlap across role-aware evaluation splits

origin.kind: scheduled 2D task execution and current-source owner audit
origin.summary: 2D-024 asked whether tuning/evaluation evidence can accidentally reuse the same image bytes under different names. Existing SampleCheck, Tool View N-image, Local Validation Set, and PinArrayGap identity owners were inspected before the smallest owner-level change.

state.current_summary: Resolved for the existing role-aware PinArrayGap Train/Validation/Test identity owner: exact source-file SHA-256 duplicates are rejected within a split and across split roles, while renamed or changed inputs make the frozen identity stale without rewriting it. General Local Validation Sets and Tool View N-image retain their existing OK/NG or UNLABELED semantics because no generic tuning/evaluation role vocabulary is product-approved.

objective.summary: Audit the current SampleCheck/N-image/Good-Bad/evaluation entry points and enforce exact-byte disjointness in the existing frozen Train/Validation/Test identity path without inventing generic role assignment.
constraints: Reuse OpenVisionRecipePinArrayGapValidationRecordStorage and the existing Local Validation Set rows; do not create a dataset database, Labeling Studio integration, or perceptual similarity detector.
Preserve source files, existing role labels, expected OK/NG semantics, and frozen-record immutability.
Keep fixtures and evidence on D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev; do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original, hardware, user data, or external services.
Do not commit, push, release, deploy, or perform external communication.

criteria.text: The role-aware Train/Validation/Test freeze path computes source SHA-256 values and rejects duplicate bytes within one split and across split roles even when paths or filenames differ.
The frozen record retains role and set-name identity; a set-name/role change or changed source becomes stale and does not rewrite the stored record.
Existing general Local Validation Set and Tool View N-image semantics remain explicit and unassigned rather than receiving an inferred tuning/evaluation role, and focused build/contract checks pass.

context.location: Sample catalog uses PairGroup/PairRole; VisionPipelineSampleCheckService executes one selected sample; VisionToolNImageVerificationService stores SourceSha256 but PairRole=UNLABELED; OpenVisionRecipeValidationSetStorage owns local OK/NG rows and path normalization; PinArrayGapValidationRecordStorage owns frozen Train/Validation/Test role identity.

PinArrayGapValidationIdentityOwner.Freeze -> PinArrayGapValidationRecordStorage.TrySave -> TryCreateRecord -> TryCreateSplitIdentity -> current file SHA-256 -> frozen XML record. Evaluate uses TryMatchesCurrent without writing the record.

Exact-byte overlap across role-aware splits is rejected with a role-specific SHA-256 disjointness error. Re-encoded/perceptually similar images are not duplicates. General local sets remain OK/NG-only and Tool View N-image remains UNLABELED.
No perceptual/re-encoded similarity, generic tuning/evaluation role vocabulary, full WPF/EXE UI matrix, hardware, release distribution, or Original repository mutation was performed.

artifacts.summary: Owner/call-path audit, exact-byte policy, focused evidence, and explicit boundaries.
Debug build and 7-case role/content identity contract output.

evidence.observation: The focused identity contract passed 7/7 cases, including same bytes under a different filename rejected across Train/Validation, renamed Validation set marked stale without record rewrite, changed image marked stale, and missing Pipeline read-only behavior.

The existing PinArrayGap identity owner now computes current file SHA-256 sets, rejects within-split duplicates and Train/Validation/Test hash overlap, and preserves Role/SetName/ContentSha256 in the existing frozen record.
Debug and Release builds completed with 0 errors and 16 pre-existing nullable warnings; the same focused contract passed 7/7 against both binaries and the targeted diff check passed.

events.summary: 2D-024 bounded role-aware content identity slice completed; existing owner and focused contract prove exact-byte duplicate rejection and stale role-change behavior.
